title: Parallel packing a square with isosceles right triangles and equilateral triangles
summary: Suppose that $I$ is a unit square. Let $T$ (resp. $Δ$) be an isosceles right triangle (resp. an equilateral triangle). We prove that any collection of triangles homothetic to $T$ (resp. $Δ$), whose total area does not exceed $\frac{1}{2}$ (resp. $\frac{\sqrt{3}}{4}$), can be parallel packed into $I$. These upper bounds are tight.
